title: Tiny, cute flower pot
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Pot body - terracotta -->
  <path d="M32 62 L38 88 Q39 92 43 92 L57 92 Q61 92 62 88 L68 62 Z" fill="#D2691E"/>
  <!-- Pot rim -->
  <rect x="28" y="56" width="44" height="10" rx="4" fill="#E8833A"/>
  <!-- Pot rim highlight -->
  <rect x="30" y="57" width="40" height="4" rx="2" fill="#F0A060"/>
  <!-- Pot body shading -->
  <path d="M36 62 L40 88 Q40 90 43 90 L45 90 L40 62 Z" fill="#B85A1A"/>
  <!-- Soil -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="59" rx="18" ry="5" fill="#5C3A1E"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="58" rx="15" ry="3" fill="#7A4E2A"/>
  
  <!-- Stem -->
  <rect x="48" y="32" width="4" height="28" rx="2" fill="#3CB043"/>
  
  <!-- Left leaf -->
  <path d="M48 44 Q38 38 34 44 Q38 50 48 46 Z" fill="#5FD36A"/>
  <path d="M48 44 Q40 41 36 44" stroke="#3CB043" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none"/>
  
  <!-- Right leaf -->
  <path d="M52 50 Q62 44 66 50 Q62 56 52 52 Z" fill="#5FD36A"/>
  <path d="M52 50 Q60 47 64 50" stroke="#3CB043" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none"/>
  
  <!-- Flower petals - bright pink/magenta -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="22" rx="7" ry="9" fill="#FF69B4"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="22" rx="7" ry="9" fill="#FF69B4" transform="rotate(72 50 26)"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="22" rx="7" ry="9" fill="#FF69B4" transform="rotate(144 50 26)"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="22" rx="7" ry="9" fill="#FF69B4" transform="rotate(216 50 26)"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="22" rx="7" ry="9" fill="#FF69B4" transform="rotate(288 50 26)"/>
  
  <!-- Petal highlights -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="20" rx="3" ry="4" fill="#FF9ECF"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="20" rx="3" ry="4" fill="#FF9ECF" transform="rotate(72 50 26)"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="20" rx="3" ry="4" fill="#FF9ECF" transform="rotate(144 50 26)"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="20" rx="3" ry="4" fill="#FF9ECF" transform="rotate(216 50 26)"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="20" rx="3" ry="4" fill="#FF9ECF" transform="rotate(288 50 26)"/>
  
  <!-- Flower center -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="26" r="6" fill="#FFD700"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="26" r="4" fill="#FFC107"/>
  <!-- Center dots -->
  <circle cx="48" cy="24" r="1" fill="#E6A800"/>
  <circle cx="52" cy="24" r="1" fill="#E6A800"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="28" r="1" fill="#E6A800"/>
  <circle cx="47" cy="27" r="0.8" fill="#E6A800"/>
  <circle cx="53" cy="27" r="0.8" fill="#E6A800"/>
  
  <!-- Tiny sparkle -->
  <circle cx="70" cy="35" r="1.5" fill="#FFFACD"/>
  <circle cx="30" cy="40" r="1" fill="#FFFACD"/>
</svg>
